pois.name: Isla Guayabo
pois.intro: L'Île Guayabo est une île du Costa Rica située dans le golfe de Nicoya de la province de Puntarenas. Elle e trouve à 8 km au sud de Puntarenas .

pois.name: Reserva Biológica Isla Guayabo
pois.intro: Guayabo Island Biological Reserve, is a protected area in Costa Rica, managed under the Tempisque Conservation Area, it was created in 1973 by executive decree 2858-A DEL. It is the location for many nesting sites for brown pelicans as well as various other species of birds.
